trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older). The rollback was applied in all regions and rolled out successfully.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001)**: Documented the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged. The incident notes recommend a follow-up investigation into the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before attempting another release.
